_README: Hand-verified observations about source PDFs that cannot be extracted from them.
Curated by a human, keyed by file_id, in the same idiom as investigations.json.
Nothing here is machine-derived; nothing here is inferred. Each entry records what
a person saw when they opened the document, and is published alongside the
machine-read status so a page can show both signals instead of picking one.
visual_draft_watermark: the page carries a visible DRAFT watermark. This is not
detectable by this pipeline. The watermark leaves no extractable text, and the
PDFs carrying it are indistinguishable from those that do not by image content
(every minutes PDF has exactly one page-1 logo image) or by vector content
(15 of 39 published documents contain curves, including two named as draft and
many named as approved; they are embedded charts in staff reports). Absence of an
entry therefore means NOT INSPECTED, never 'no watermark'.
